corpora.seed: evals; all 280 seed examples, current context

contrasts.baseline vs atomic: Production predicates versus decomposed factual predicates with explicit criteria. Deliberately removes task exceptions to measure factual sensitivity; atomic alone is not a deployable rule policy.
contrasts.atomic vs policy: Identical state and factual questions; adds a separately scored, negated explicit-permission predicate.

composition: min(factual probabilities, 1 - permission probability); this is a heuristic decision score, not calibrated joint probability
thresholds: unchanged production thresholds; no post-hoc selection or default promotion
independence: Existing synthetic development corpora, not held-out or independently reviewed release evidence
analysis: verify factual question/state identities between atomic and policy
record raw permission scores and orientation
report every rule including regressions, coverage and source-resolution limitations
compare explicit-task and vague-task examples without relabeling
